facts.value: As part of your study program in our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules in other departments, known as import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.

For the study programs of the Department of Economics, an overview has been compiled of which import modules you can register for in other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your study program in the Department of Economics.
Furthermore, you cannot incorporate any other modules from other departments into your study program in the Department of Economics and also cannot earn differing Credit Points (CP).
